notes_for_editor: Thin: one transcribed line from the state's 12th Biennial Report (1948), with no construction detail, staffing, fate or current condition. The Plymouth and Scuppernong entries are cited only as context in the same county. Name clash: a 1930s newspaper item quoted on the Crisp County, Georgia page of the same cache mentions a tower 'two miles south of Wenona' in Georgia; it is not this tower and was not used. The record's NGS register entry (state number EY 4028) matches the code in the tnlandforms list; the list does not explain the code, so it was not used. Search results turned up a Wenona community profile (roadsidethoughts.com) that was not opened and is not used. The cached NHLR North Carolina index lists 31 registered lookouts and does not include Wenona. Access is not in any source, so no access fact is set.
